strings.zh: 洞穴探险时,驱虫喷雾器{NEWLINE}可以发挥巨大作用！{SCROLL}如果你觉得一路上{NEWLINE}野生精灵出现得太频繁,{CLEAR}就多带几瓶驱虫喷雾吧！
strings.en: Repels are a huge help when you’re{NEWLINE}exploring caves!{SCROLL}If you feel like wild Pokémon keep{NEWLINE}showing up too often on the way, bring a{CLEAR}few extra Repels!

strings.zh: 听说在城都地区一个叫做{NEWLINE}桧皮镇的地方,有一位工匠{CLEAR}能用柑果制球！{SCROLL}我也想让他帮我做啊！
strings.en: I heard there’s a craftsman in a place{NEWLINE}in Johto called Azalea Town who can{CLEAR}make Poké Balls out of Apricorns!{SCROLL}I want him to make some for me too!

strings.zh: 实在抱歉,{NEWLINE}因为前几天被火箭队洗劫过,{CLEAR}能所以现在店里没有能卖的商品了……
strings.en: I’m terribly sorry. Team Rocket{NEWLINE}ransacked the shop a few days ago, so{CLEAR}we have nothing left to sell right now...

strings.zh: 随着获得徽章数的增多,{NEWLINE}道馆挑战的难度也会不断增加,{CLEAR}规则也可能会变得五花八门。
strings.en: The more Badges you earn, the harder{NEWLINE}Gym challenges get. The rules might get{CLEAR}pretty unusual too.
